ja287:1.2: an actor, who creates a commotion,
ja287:1.3: Gains are received amongst the fools,
ja287:1.4: this is my instruction to you.
ja287:2.1: Cursed be those gains of fame
ja287:2.2: and those gains of wealth, O brahmin,
ja287:2.3: Whatever livelihood is gained through destruction
ja287:3.2: and without a home I would wander forth,
ja287:3.4: than seeking out whatever is wrong.
